title: quest agents --check silently defaults to --target codex, so a Claude-only project checks the wrong file
description: ADR gap 4, at opum-doc main 2112fc6, docs/adr/distribute-lore-and-quest-agent-skills-through-the-plugin-marketplace.md (operator ruling 2026-09-25T14:09:02.971Z, dispatched by opum-agent as OPAG-421). agents --check with no --target checks AGENTS.md (the codex default, agent-instructions.ts:33, main.ts:1345), so a Claude-only project exits 0 without having checked CLAUDE.md or the Claude skill. The ADR leaves the choice to quest-cli: require --target, pick a smarter default, or document the default as intentional. It must be decided and recorded.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The decision (require --target, a smarter default, or a documented intentional default) is recorded with its reasoning on this task
In a Claude-only project, quest agents --check with no --target no longer exits 0 without checking the Claude instructions, or the documented default states exactly what it checks
Help, the guides and the managed block describe the chosen behaviour, and a test covers it
